headline: GW 2 CROWN: BENN MWANGI CLAIMS SUPREME GLORY AS SAMUEL WAMBUA ANCHORS THE CLOWN CAR!
subheadline: Official Issue #2: Masterclass at the summit, carnage at the bottom, and an unfiltered autopsy of the weekend.
weather_report: Heavy rain of green arrows for the champion; flash flood of tears in 10th place.
editorial_lead: Welcome to Issue #2 of The FPL Boys Gazette! Gameweek 2 kicked off with high drama and tactical showdowns across all 10 managers. Leading from the front, Benn Mwangi (Odysseus Reign) put on a championship display, amassing a league-high 118 points to secure top honors and pocket Ksh. 250.00 in prize money. However, for every champion standing proudly on the podium, there is a casualty in the trenches. At the very bottom of the table, Samuel Wambua (maggry shiners fc) suffered a complete tactical meltdown with only 55 points, officially earning the unwanted wooden spoon. Read through the full breakdown below for the complete manager-by-manager autopsy!
clown_reason: Samuel Wambua collapsed to rank #10 with just 55 points. A textbook disasterclass that will be studied in tactical defense academies as what NOT to do.
king_reason: Benn Mwangi dominated the round with 118 net points, bagging Ksh. 250.00. An imperious showing that sets the early benchmark for the rest of the league to chase!
quote_of_the_week: "My rank is only temporary. By Gameweek 38, they will see the vision." — Samuel Wambua
defaulter_roast: 🚨 LEAGUE GRACE PERIOD (GW 2): The League Committee has officially declared a full grace period for GW 1 & GW 2! Zero late penalty fines apply for all managers. Defaulters get a clean slate for the opening fortnight—strict Ksh. 50 fines will be enforced by the Treasurer starting GW 3!
transfer_hit_roast: Transfer Market Alert: Samuel Wambua took a -8 point hit in transfers, finishing with 55 net points. A costly gamble that did not quite deliver the expected dividends.

manager_roasts.roast_title: Benn Mwangi - Tactical Masterclass & GW Winner
manager_roasts.roast_body: Benn Mwangi's 'Odysseus Reign' delivered a statement performance with 118 points, taking 1st place and Ksh. 250.00.

manager_roasts.roast_title: Renny Muragu - The Young Ones Schooling The Elders
manager_roasts.roast_body: Renny's 'The Young Ones' showed mature nerve with 116 points to pocket Ksh. 166.67 on the podium.

manager_roasts.roast_title: Bright Ottore - Money In The Bank
manager_roasts.roast_body: Bright Ottore's 'Phill Me In FC' secured 🥉 place with 114 points and Ksh. 83.33.

manager_roasts.roast_title: King Chris - Agonizingly Close To The Money
manager_roasts.roast_body: King Chris's 'The_Painter..' scored 105 points to finish rank #4, missing the podium cash by just a few points. Pure agony.
Erick's 'mambaaa' didn't deliver the fatal bite promised, slithering into rank #5 with 102 points.
Marvin Owino's 'Don Bosco' registered 79 points to settle into rank #6.
Marve Mathingu's 'Marve of the Match' registered 77 points to settle into rank #7.

manager_roasts.roast_title: Torque Dennis - Dangerously Close To The Bottom
manager_roasts.roast_body: Torque Dennis's 'DenniSkills' finished with 76 points at rank #8. Urgent tactical surgery required.

manager_roasts.roast_title: Aron Mangati - Saved From The Clown Hat By A Whisker
manager_roasts.roast_body: Aron's 61-point return left him lingering dangerously at rank #9, barely escaping the wooden spoon.
manager_roasts.verdict: Verdict: One Foot In The Abyss

manager_roasts.roast_body: An unforgettable disasterclass of 55 points to claim the wooden spoon at rank #10. Footballing crime committed.
